text:
alex: Quick sync: iterating on the playground streaming UX. goal: make streaming feel controllable, surface cost, and keep prompt library insertion frictionless.
priya: short ask: split semantics clearly. 'Hold' should pause and allow resume, 'Cancel' should stop and discard intermediate text.
marco: rename idea: 'Hold' + 'Stop & Retry'. 'Retry' implies running again. keep regen action next to message.
sam: token indicator question: live estimate per-response, plus an optional conversation total in the left rail. users want immediate feedback when a response is about to be expensive.
jen: suggest small inline badge: "resp 98 | conv 2.1k". make the response number live and the convo number update on commit to reduce noise.
kate: accessibility: role=status with aria-live="polite" for streaming updates but avoid reading every token increment. batch updates (every 250ms).
design-bot: contrast check: token badge text contrast 3.4:1 with current palette. needs improvement for small text.
priya: colorblind friendliness: add a shape (diamond) to indicate streaming vs done. avoid using only green.
marco: layout: on narrow widths, collapse token badge and actions into a chevron menu. overflow threshold at 560px.
sam: keyboard: propose `Space` to toggle Hold, `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` to Regenerate. show hint in tooltip.
jen: microcopy: primary action labeled 'Hold' (tooltip: 'Pause streaming output; resume to continue'). secondary 'Stop & Retry' (tooltip: 'Stop and generate a new response').
alex: visual treatment for streaming: thin dashed underline for uncommitted tokens -> solid when committed. add a subtle pulse indicator next to badge. pulse must be aria-hidden.
kate: screen reader note: when streaming completes, announce 'Response complete' once, not every partial event. use a completion event.
marco: prompt library flow: add Quick Insert icon on each snippet. clicking opens a compact variable editor overlay so users can fill template vars before insertion.
jen: UX edge-case: inserting a prompt while streaming should surface a modal: 'Inserting this prompt will cancel the current response. Continue? [Cancel] [Insert]'. keep buttons keyboard-focusable.
sam: telemetry: record accidental cancels, quick-insert conversions, and keybinding usage. propose an experiment comparing inline vs overlay variable editor for insertion speed.
priya: conservative token calc preferred. show an estimated token count while streaming but flag it as 'estimate' and recompute on finish.
design-bot: spec v4 uploaded: https://redwood/specs/playground/stream-ux/v4
alex: rollout plan: phase 1 keyboard + aria + microcopy, phase 2 compact badge + overflow, phase 3 prompt quick-insert overlay.
marco: prototyping: I'll mock the compact badge + chevron overflow today and add narrow breakpoint screenshots.
jen: I'll implement aria-live batching and the keyboard handlers once prototype lands.
kate: I'll write the accessibility checklist: aria labels, live region behavior, contrast tokens, screen reader completion announcements.
priya: copy for empty library: 'Your prompt library is empty — add templates with Quick Insert or import examples.' shorter than current text.
sam: confirm analytics events: 'hold_toggled', 'stop_and_retry', 'quick_insert_used', 'tokens_estimated', 'tokens_finalized'.
alex: great. can everyone drop a quick screenshot or gif in this thread when they have mocks? pulling together a final spec after that. thanks all.
